properties.areaDesc: Montague
properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 15 at 4:01AM CDT by NWS Fort Worth TX
properties.description:
At 400 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from near Sugden to near Terral to near Bellevue.
Movement was northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Winds in excess of 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Strong thunderstorms will be near...
Nocona around 415 AM CDT.

Other locations impacted by these storms include Spanish Fort,
Stoneburg, Belcherville, Bonita, Capps Corner, Montague, Ringgold,
Nocona Hills, and Illinois Bend.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

NWSheadline: Strong thunderstorms will impact portions of Montague County through 430 AM CDT
